title: Dome of the Rock
blurb: The 691-692 CE Umayyad shrine: an octagonal arcade around a 20 m gilded dome on a windowed drum, enclosing the Foundation Stone.

systems.name: Dome
systems.description: The gilded 20 m dome with its inner wooden shell and crescent finial.

systems.name: Drum
systems.description: The cylindrical drum with its ring of windows.

systems.name: Drum supports
systems.description: The 4 piers and 12 columns carrying the drum.

systems.name: Octagonal arcade
systems.description: The inner octagonal arcade of 24 piers and columns.

systems.name: Outer walls
systems.description: The octagonal outer walls with window bands, cornice and plinth.

systems.name: Entrances
systems.description: The four entrances on the cardinal axes with porches and steps.

systems.name: Foundation Stone
systems.description: The sacred rock enclosed by the shrine.
